profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Oracle Corporation
profile.summary:
I have over fifteen years of software development experience using Microsoft technologies and have experience in all aspects of the development life cycle beginning with requirements gathering and ending with customer support.

I have worked as a developer and technical lead on several different software development projects. I have worked using both traditional software development methologies and more recently using the scrum agile methodology. I have acted as a liaison between clients and development staff to ensure any applicaton issues are properly addressed. I have also worked providing technical guidance and subject matter expertise to other developers in my team.

Specialties: .NET Framework, ASP.NET, C#, VB.NET, SQL, Application and Database design, Scrum, AJAX, LINQ to SQL, SSRS, Azure,  SQL Azure, SharePoint.
